race.title: Watch Racing TV In HD Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: This looks a really hot race but ALBIE LITTLEWOOD is fancied to complete the 4-timer having still been able to make a winning start over fences despite market weakness at Worcester last month. Smart Decision jumped well for a long way when a close second over C&D on his chasing bow, whilst Ninna Collina was 3-3 over hurdles last season and has the physique to make an even better chaser. ALBIE LITTLEWOOD (IRE) SMART DECISION NINNA COLLINA
